canonical_architecture.workspace_loop: the same source-owning model chooses tools or submits complete source; runtime executes the exact source and returns raw source-owned observations to that same model
canonical_architecture.artifact_policy: substantive artifacts are stored once by content hash; control state carries references
canonical_architecture.confirmatory_policy: source iteration stops at execution validity; realized values, threshold verdicts, value-derived hashes, and the active evaluator seed are withheld from candidate generation and semantic review; after independent semantic ACCEPT the immutable outcome is released once to Architect, and any continuation receives a fresh evaluator-owned cohort
canonical_architecture.authority_policy: review, retrieval, simulation, and compiler feedback are not proof; exact target-bound Lean or AXLE kernel evidence is required
canonical_architecture.repair_boundary: there is no canonical RepairAgent or content-patching harness; only bounded same-owner source iteration and transient transport/schema retry
forbidden_patterns: runtime-authored statistical or Lean source repair
routine Architect routing inside a source workspace
nested full task or artifact payload copies
source optimization against frozen confirmatory outcomes
